brief: Reduce the permissible load on Draycott Green according to MG-021, accounting for ambient de-rating based on the preceding 24 hours. Because the supplied documents do not cover ONAN cooling configuration specifics for forced cooling adjustments, apply only the ambient de-rating and sustained event reductions specified in MG-021. Furthermore, as directed by MG-023, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure.
